verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a learning system: developers' 👍/👎 reactions and explanatory reply comments train it, and after 2-3 weeks it stops commenting on things the team doesn't care about. Its noise control also skips repetitive feedback. This directly matches pushing back on rejected feedback and having the reviewer stop repeating it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that rejected comments actually stop recurring, and evidence of faster-than-weeks or per-comment suppression (learning is described as gradual over 2-3 weeks).
